about.title: About Alzain Tea
about.subtitle: A passion for authenticity and mastery in every fine tea leaf
about.storyContent: Alzain Tea was founded with a profound dedication to authentic tea culture. We travel the globe to handpick the finest tea leaves from historic estates in Sri Lanka, India, China, and Japan, delivering unparalleled quality to discerning tea enthusiasts across the Gulf and worldwide.
about.missionContent: To provide a complete tea journey marrying supreme leaf quality, artisan packaging, and expedited delivery so every brew is fresh, fragrant, and memorable.
about.qualityContent: We adhere to the highest standards of purity, selecting natural harvest free of artificial additives.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our teas, orders, delivery, and payments

items.q: Which countries do you ship to?
items.a: We ship directly to all GCC nations (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar) as well as worldwide international delivery.
GCC delivery typically takes between 2 to 5 business days. Exact delivery estimates appear at checkout.
We support secure payments including mada, Apple Pay, Visa, MasterCard, and Stripe.

items.q: How do you ensure tea freshness and aroma?
items.a: All our teas are packaged in specialized airtight, light-blocking tins and bags that seal in aromatic oils and peak freshness.
